description: Get weekly CFTC Commitment of Traders (COT) positioning data for a currency's FX futures contract on the CME, covering speculator positioning, non-commercial longs vs shorts, hedge-fund FX positioning, and sentiment extremes. Returns weekly snapshots with long/short open interest by trader category. Updated every Friday at 15:30 ET reflecting the Tuesday cutoff. USD (the USD Index contract) is available without an API key for the most recent 90 days on a 15-minute release delay; every other currency and the full history need an API key. Supported currencies: AUD, CAD, CHF, EUR, GBP, JPY, NZD, USD, XAU. Access: USD is available without an API key; every other currency returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code for the FX futures contract (case-insensitive). Supported: AUD, CAD, CHF, EUR, GBP, JPY, NZD, USD, XAU.

instrument.description: Any CFTC contract by instrument id (rates, equity, energy, metals and micro contracts) instead of a currency. Use `list` to see the supported instrument/report combinations.

limit.description: Rows per page for instrument reads (1-100).

report.description: CFTC report type. Omit for the Legacy futures-only report (commercial / non-commercial / non-reportable). One of: legacy_futures, legacy_combined, tff_futures, tff_combined, disaggregated_futures. TFF reports return dealer, asset manager, leveraged funds and other reportable positions for FX contracts and the dollar index; disaggregated_futures is published for XAU (COMEX gold) only.

name: cot_data
title: COT Report
